summary: Parity and reliability pass: live sync wired end to end (filesystem watcher, notify_push, per-file progress, activity log), deletion-review dialog, Show Log, and portable release binaries.
changelog: Filesystem changes now trigger automatic synchronization (per-folder watcher).
notify_push connects at startup, so remote changes sync instantly instead of polling.
Live per-file progress and an activity log fed from every finished synchronization.
Deletion-guard alerts open a review dialog (Keep Paused / Restore / Approve once).
Show Log button in the header and a complete per-folder menu (Edit ignored files, Remove).
Release binaries are portable: no host-specific instructions (fixes crashes on CPUs without AVX-512).
